summary: Buin Airport (UBI) is a small regional airfield serving the town of Buin in the Autonomous Region of Bougainville, Papua New Guinea. Situated on the southern coast of Bougainville Island, it provides essential air access to a remote area historically tied to copper mining and surrounded by lush tropical terrain. The airport primarily handles domestic flights and supports the connectivity needs of local communities in this isolated part of the Pacific.
faqs:
Q: What is the IATA code for Buin Airport?
A: The IATA code is UBI.

Q: Where is Buin Airport located?
A: It is located near the town of Buin in the Autonomous Region of Bougainville, Papua New Guinea.

Q: What type of flights does Buin Airport handle?
A: It primarily serves small domestic flights connecting Buin with other towns in Bougainville and mainland Papua New Guinea.

Q: Is Buin Airport open to international flights?
A: No, it is a small regional airport and does not handle scheduled international flights.
transport_tips: Ground transportation options at Buin Airport are limited due to the remote location; travelers typically arrange vehicles in advance through local contacts or accommodations. Road travel from the airport to Buin town is straightforward but conditions can vary depending on weather. There is no public bus service, so pre-booking a transfer is strongly recommended.
local_tip: Bring cash in small denominations, as ATMs are scarce in Buin and many local businesses may not accept cards.
